tutorial.info: Round, declarer (team and contract value), trump (shown as "Hidden" until revealed), and each team's game points are shown here. The first team to reach the target game points (default 6) wins. The ★ marks the declarer.
tutorial.trick: Cards played to the current trick appear here. Follow the led suit. The hidden trump is revealed the moment you can no longer follow. Card points are J=3, 9=2, A=1, 10=1, plus +1 for the last trick — 29 in all. Trick rank is J > 9 > A > 10 > K > Q > 8 > 7, and trumps beat plain cards.
tutorial.hand: This is your hand. During play, click a playable card and press Play.
tutorial.actions: In the bidding phase, buttons appear for Pass / 16 / 20 / 24 / 28. Only a bid higher than the current highest is selectable. The highest bidder's team picks a hidden trump and plays eight tricks. If the bidding team captures at least its bid in card points it scores +1 game point; otherwise the other team scores +1. The first team to the target game points wins.
